t: This is St Luke's, a Church of England parish church on Oseney Crescent in Kentish Town. It is Grade II* listed. The church was closed from 1991 to 2011, and today it is active again, hosting a church plant from Holy Trinity Brompton. It was designed by Basil Champneys, an English architect and author. He is best known for academic buildings, including the John Rylands Library in Manchester, and colleges at Oxford and Cambridge such as Newnham, Lady Margaret Hall and Mansfield.
